summary: An overdue snowshoer was found injured near Jenny Creek Trail after an eight-hour search on February 22, 2021. Teams evacuated her by snowmobile to a medical helicopter.
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: ART mission 2021-025. | Run 748: SnowBrains corroboration merged (parent-opened): 47yo Boulder woman, solo snowshoe on Jenny Creek Trail from Eldora Nordic Center Sunday 2021-02-21, family reported missing next day; RMRG + Flight for Life search; found ~200 ft off trail after ~8 hours, severe injuries, snowmobile to LZ, Flight for Life to hospital, expected to survive.
